Kingmakers - Official Gameplay Deep Dive Trailer
Join developers Redemption Road for a deep dive into the gameplay of Kingmakers in this latest trailer for the upcoming third-person shooter game. The new video showcases a peek at the map, combat, the story, and RTS mechanics. Kingmakers will be available on PC.

In Kingmakers, go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op for up to four players.

System Intruder - Official Announcement Trailer
Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for System Intruder, a retro first-person cyberpunk adventure shooter developed by R_Games. Miniopolis - Official Announcement Trailer
Here's your look at the Miniopolis announcement trailer for this upcoming resource-free city-building sandbox game, where you can build the way you want. Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Miniopolis will be available on PC (via Steam). A demo is coming soon.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Twitch CEO Expects GTA Online 2 in 2027 - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy thinkgs GTA 6's grip on gaming culture won't let up even into next year, when he says GTA 6 2 will launch. Via Bloomberg, Clancy said we'll see a "big bump with GTA 6," but also another huge one when multiplayer drops next year. Rockstar has not formally announced their GTA Online plans post-GTA 6, but it's all but inevitable GTA Online continues with GTA 6 as the framework, much like how GTA 5 was the foundation for GTA Online. Parent company Take-Two, for its part, is ready to support the current iteration of GTA Online as long as gamers want to keep playing it. In other news, The Blood of Dawnwalker will get a New Game+ mode eventually, according to the game's director. And Gen-Xers and Millenials rejoice! Toys 'R' Us is making a big retail push this holiday season, opening 120 new standalone stores that will cater to nostalgic adults and today's content creators.

text:
Fate/Extra Record - Official Caster Character Trailer
Meet Caster (VA: Chiwa Saito) in this latest Fate/Extra Record trailer for this upcoming RPG, and learn more about this sorceress with exceptional knowledge who excels at tactical combat. Caster is one of the Servants the protagonist can make a contract with. Fate/Extra Record will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on January 28, 2027.

Based on Fate/Extra, which released on the PlayStation Portable in 2010, Fate/Extra Record revises and expands the narrative to add new layers and depth to one of the franchise’s core entries, while also modernizing the title’s audio-visual presentation and adding an all-new strategic battle system that combines turn-based battles with a unique deck-building system.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
PlayStation’s Creative Future Has Never Looked Bleaker
Cutting ties with Kojima and poor Wolverine reviews are just the latest issues in a difficult generation for PlayStation. The platform's creartive future has never looked bleaker. 
It’s impossible to know how PlayStation bosses felt after seeing many critics walk away from Insomniac’s Wolverine with an apathetic shrug. A sub-80 on Metacritic is infamously considered a disaster in the triple-A space, and so Sony certainly won’t be thrilled, but it would be easy for the company to brush this away as an uncharacteristic miss. However, that would require wilfully ignoring the sad reality that PlayStation Studios is currently far from fertile ground for single-player adventures. 

Never has it been clearer that PlayStation Studios needs to find the next evolutionary stage of the “traditional” video game. Never has it been clearer that it needs its next Metal Gear Solid, the revolutionary Hideo Kojima game that defined what we could expect from PlayStation back in 1998.

Now would be a very good time, then, for Sony to cancel Hideo Kojima’s PlayStation-exclusive spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid...
